title: Ridgeline Installation Services Installation Scheduling, Lead Times and Customer Reschedules
content:
This guidance governs booking and moving installation dates on Ridgeline Installation Services contracts.

## Booking an installation date

- An installation is scheduled only after the materials status is received, on a program that requires materials to be received first, and only after the permit status is issued, when the job requires a permit and the program requires an issued permit first.
- The installation date may be no earlier than the program's earliest-installation figure, in calendar days, after the later of the contract signing date and the materials received date. The first date booked is kept as the original installation date.
- The materials lead time quoted to the customer at signing is the typical time to materials receipt and is never a promised date.
- Materials and permit status are recorded by the store and the permit office, never on the customer's say-so.

*Hypothetical:* signed 1 May, materials received 20 May, program figure 21 days: the earliest installation date is 10 June.

## Moving a booked installation

A booked installation can be moved only while the contract status is scheduled.

A customer reschedule is free when it is requested at least the program's free-reschedule notice hours before the start of the booked arrival window (full 60-minute periods counted back from the window start; exactly that many hours qualifies) and the contract's customer reschedule count before the request is below the program's reschedule limit. A customer reschedule that does not meet both conditions is not free.

> Otherwise one reschedule fee line posts, referencing the reschedule request — this clause is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis for the customer reschedule fee.

Every customer reschedule adds one to the customer reschedule count. A reschedule made on Ridgeline's or the installer's side never incurs a fee and is not counted.

## Free reschedule test (hypothetical 72-hour notice, limit of 3, window starting Monday 08:00)

| Requested | Count before the request | Free |
|---|---|---|
| Friday 08:00 (72 full hours) | 2 | yes |
| Friday 08:30 (71 full hours) | 2 | no |
| Thursday 10:00 (94 full hours) | 3 | no |
| Saturday 12:00 (44 full hours) | 3 | no |
| Moved by Ridgeline's installer | any | no fee; the count does not change |

superseded_clauses: otherwise one install_fee_charged row with fee_type reschedule_fee posts, referencing the reschedule request.
